<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that users cannot assign claims-handling roles to staff due to lack of group mapping or role-assignment guidance. I checked the five most similar items: bulk document upload (4127), document classifier threshold (4133), task overview dashboard, workspace administration (4131), and claim search refinements (4128). None address role assignment or group mapping; the closest, workspace administration, covers permissions and team organization generally but not the specific problem of mapping existing groups or guiding role assignment for claims handling. All similarity scores are very low (max 0.061), confirming no shipped story or roadmap item covers this problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
